tldr: 台股加權指數重挫 3.88% 至約 45,212 點，全球 AI 晶片賣壓衝擊亞股。
聯發科首顆 AI ASIC 放量，第四季雲端 ASIC 營收上修至約 25 億美元、2027 年目標達 160 億美元。
波動加劇下，高盛傾向以選擇權避險；美債固定利率走高吸引穩健收益型投資人。

items.title_zh: 台股重挫 3.88%，全球晶片賣壓擴散
items.title_en: Taiwan shares tumble 3.88% as the global chip sell-off deepens
items.summary_zh: 台股加權指數 10 月 30 日收跌 3.88% 至約 45,212 點，櫃買指數下跌 4.4%，AI 晶片賣壓席捲亞股。盤後壓力延續，美股科技股走弱、那斯達克重挫逾 2% 創約兩個多月低點，台積電 ADR 跌逾 3%，台灣 AI 供應鏈短線仍偏弱。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's weighted index closed down 3.88% at about 45,212 on Oct 30, with the OTC index off 4.4%, as a broad AI-chip rout spread across Asia. The pressure extended overnight: US tech stocks slid, the Nasdaq fell more than 2% to a roughly two-month low and TSMC's ADR dropped over 3%, leaving Taiwan's AI supply chain on the defensive.

items.title_zh: 〈聯發科法說〉首顆 AI ASIC 放量，Q4 貢獻上修至 25 億美元
items.title_en: MediaTek's first AI ASIC ramps, lifting its Q4 cloud-revenue outlook to US$2.5bn
items.summary_zh: 聯發科執行長蔡力行於法說會表示，首款 AI 加速器 ASIC 已於 9 月出貨，受惠客戶需求強勁，第四季雲端 ASIC 營收可達約 25 億美元；2027 年該專案營收可望達目標高標約 160 億美元，約占整體 AI ASIC 市場兩成，基板產能仍是供應鏈較具挑戰的環節。
items.summary_en: At its earnings call, MediaTek said its first AI-accelerator ASIC began shipping in September and that strong customer demand lifts Q4 cloud-ASIC revenue to about US$2.5bn. It expects the project to reach the high end of its target, roughly US$16bn, in 2027 — around 20% of the AI-ASIC market — while working with suppliers to secure scarce substrate capacity.

items.title_zh: 蕭美琴提無人機三大方向，打造 100% 非紅信賴供應鏈
items.title_en: Vice President Hsiao outlines three pillars for a "100% non-red" drone supply chain
items.summary_zh: 副總統蕭美琴於「2026 無人機國際論壇」表示，政府將無人系統列為國家戰略最優先項目之一，要打造世界級「無人機國家隊」。將以非紅、值得信賴的供應鏈、邊緣運算與軟體定義創新、無人機外交三大支柱推進，鞏固台灣作為民主無人機供應鏈亞洲中心，應用橫跨國防與農業、交通等民生領域。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 International Drone Forum, Vice President Hsiao Mei-chin said unmanned systems are a top national-strategy priority and pledged a world-class "drone national team." The plan rests on three pillars — a non-red, trusted supply chain, edge-computing and software-defined innovation, and "drone diplomacy" partnerships — positioning Taiwan as Asia's hub for a democratic drone supply chain across defence and civilian uses.

items.title_zh: 八貫前三季 EPS 5.7 元，已賺贏去年全年
items.title_en: Baguang's nine-month EPS of NT$5.7 already tops all of 2025
items.summary_zh: TPU 材料廠八貫公布第三季 EPS 1.6 元，前三季累計 EPS 達 5.7 元，已超越 2025 年全年獲利。受惠戶外、醫療應用擴大與航太、航海、軍工客戶強勁拉貨及標案出貨，單季營收 9.4 億元、年增 53.78%，毛利率升至 25.15%。公司表示新接訂單已排到 2027 年第二季後，訂單能見度強勁。
items.summary_en: TPU-material maker Baguang reported Q3 EPS of NT$1.6 and cumulative nine-month EPS of NT$5.7, beating its full-year 2025 profit, as outdoor, medical, aerospace, marine and defence demand lifted Q3 revenue 53.8% YoY to NT$940m with gross margin rising to 25.15%. Management says new orders are now booked through Q2 2027, pointing to strong order visibility.

items.title_zh: 台中銀統籌 23 億元聯貸，支持高雄舊市議會都更案
items.title_en: Taichung Bank leads NT$2.3bn syndicated loan for a Kaohsiung urban-renewal project
items.summary_zh: 台中銀行統籌主辦崇偉營造承攬之「高雄市舊市議會公辦都更新建工程主體工程」23 億元聯合授信案，攜手合庫、臺灣企銀、全國農業金庫共同主辦，並邀高雄銀行參貸，10 月 28 日完成簽約。本案結合歷史建築保存與都市機能再造，位於高雄亞洲資產管理中心專區，展現銀行同業合作支持重大公共建設。
items.summary_en: Taichung Bank arranged a NT$2.3bn joint credit facility for Chong-Wei Construction's main-structure contract on the Kaohsiung Old City Council public urban-renewal project, co-organised with Cooperative Bank, Taiwan SME Bank and the National Agricultural Credit Union, with Kaohsiung Bank participating. Signed Oct 28, the deal shows domestic banks jointly financing major public construction tied to the city's asset-management-centre zone.

items.title_zh: 台灣金聯 25 週年啟動「永續三安 2.0」，跨足不動產控股
items.title_en: Taiwan Jinlian marks 25 years, launching "Sustainable San'an 2.0" and a real-estate holding push
items.summary_zh: 台灣金聯舉辦 25 週年茶會，董事長宮文萍宣布推動「居住正義永續三安」2.0 版，定位「居住正義國家隊」，由資產處置業者轉型為具完整產業鏈的不動產控股公司。措施涵蓋都更全案管理與前期資金墊付、建商續建資金承諾以防爛尾樓，並結合安養信託擴大社宅參與，財政部、金管會等官員出席見證。
items.summary_en: At its 25th-anniversary event, Chairperson Gong Wen-ping announced an upgraded "Housing Justice" programme and said the firm will reposition from an asset-disposal operator into a fully integrated real-estate holding company — a "national team" for housing justice. Measures span urban-renewal case management, construction-completion financing to avert stalled projects, and rent-management linked to retirement trusts.

items.title_zh: 美國抗通膨儲蓄債券利率升至 5.51%，固定利率創近 20 年新高
items.title_en: US inflation-protected savings bonds now yield 5.51%, with the fixed rate at a near-20-year high
items.summary_zh: 美國抗通膨儲蓄債券（I Bonds）綜合年利率升至 5.51%，其中固定利率部分攀升至近 20 年新高。固定利率走高意味即使通膨回落，實質報酬仍較具支撐，對追求抗通膨與穩健現金流的投資人而言，是配置海外固定收益、分散資產時值得留意的選項。
items.summary_en: The composite annual rate on US inflation-indexed savings bonds has risen to 5.51%, and the fixed-rate component has climbed to its highest in nearly two decades. A higher fixed rate makes the real return more durable even if inflation eases, drawing interest from income-focused and conservative investors weighing inflation-hedged, overseas fixed-income allocations.

items.title_zh: 高盛調整 AI 布局：以選擇權「租用」上漲、買賣權當保險
items.title_en: Goldman reshapes its AI trade: rent the upside with options, buy puts as insurance
items.summary_zh: 高盛建議投資人透過買進買權「租用」AI 反彈的上漲空間，並搭配賣權作為下跌保險，而非直接做多。該行指出，今年其動量股票籃子已有逾 30 次單日波動超過 5%，頻率甚至高於 2000 年網路泡沫、2008 年金融危機與疫情期間，因此傾向以限制損失方式參與年底行情，兼顧資產配置的抗震與參與度。
items.summary_en: Goldman Sachs is advising clients to "rent" an AI rebound via call options while pairing them with puts for downside protection, rather than going outright long. With its momentum basket seeing more than 30 single-day swings above 5% this year — more frequent than in 2000, 2008 or the pandemic — the bank wants to join a year-end rally while capping losses.
